headline: The new Ibovespa theoretical portfolio takes effect in the next session, and local desks spent this one printing large one-way blocks on the eve of it.
Local desks sold SLCE3 and CMIN3 to foreign accounts in single-direction blocks, with one house well ahead of the others.
The same desks bought CPLE3 from retail accounts on the same session, the other side of the day's single theme.
A dozen candidates closed with 26-63% of their turnover inside the closing auction — a common closing event to rule out before reading any of them as flow.
